# technitium_settings_proxy_forwarders (Data Source)

Reads what `technitium_settings_proxy_forwarders` manages, without managing it.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Read-Only

- `concurrent_forwarding` (Boolean) Query several forwarders at once, picked by their average latency, instead of one after another, and use the first answer. When none answers in time, the next ones are tried until all have been.
- `forwarder_concurrency` (Number) The number of forwarders queried at the same time.
- `forwarder_protocol` (String) The protocol for reaching the forwarders: `Udp`, `Tcp`, `Tls`, `Https` or `Quic`.
- `forwarder_retries` (Number) The number of retries when querying forwarders.
- `forwarder_timeout` (Number) The timeout in milliseconds when querying forwarders.
- `forwarders` (List of String) The forwarders to send queries to. An empty list clears them, so the server resolves recursively itself.
- `id` (String) The identifier, as the resource has it.
- `proxy_address` (String) The proxy's host name or IP address.
- `proxy_bypass` (List of String) The IP addresses, networks in CIDR notation and host or domain names that never go through the proxy.
- `proxy_password` (String, Sensitive) The proxy password.
- `proxy_port` (Number) The proxy's port.
- `proxy_type` (String) The proxy for outbound requests: `None`, `Http` or `Socks5`.
- `proxy_username` (String) The proxy username.
